items.p: A follower count is a number. A community turns up, replies, defends you and buys. We build for the second one.
Every idea is tied to something a client needs — a launch, a market, a number. Creative without a job to do is just content.

items.t: Make people feel part of it.
items.p: The best thing we ever made worked because the audience felt let in, not sold to.
Shared calendars, honest reporting, real numbers — including the ones that did not work. You always know what is happening and why.
